description: Keep a rented number for another period: the period is added to its current end, at today's price for that period in its country (see get_rental_offers). Possible from 2 hours after renting until 20 minutes before the end. Debits the wallet only if the renewal goes through. WARNING: this spends real wallet balance; confirm the number, period and price with the user first.

number.description: The rented number, as rent_number or list_rentals gave it ("+", spaces and dashes are ignored).

period.description: Rental period: "oneDay" (1 day), "oneWeek" (1 week), "oneMonth" (1 month), "threeMonths" (3 months), "sixMonths" (6 months), "twelveMonths" (12 months). Not every period is on sale in every country: check get_rental_offers.

name: renew_rental
title: Renew a rented number
